description: This file is a shell script used for testing cherry-pick and revert operations in a git repository. It defines a series of setup steps and test cases to verify git commands related to cherry-picking and reverting root commits.

methods.name: test_expect_success
methods.description: Defines a test case expecting successful execution.

methods.name: test_tick
methods.description: Advances the test clock to ensure unique timestamps.

methods.name: test_cmp
methods.description: Compares the contents of two files to verify they are identical.

methods.name: test_path_is_missing
methods.description: Checks if a specified file is missing from the filesystem.

methods.name: test_must_fail
methods.description: Confirms that a command fails as expected.
